name: 15-fast-reps-and-too-fast-bounce
description: Simulated, 30 fps, 1 px noise: fast push-ups (75°, 0.3 s down, no hold, 0.3 s up, 0.2 s rest) count; one 0.15 s-each-way bounce (60°) reaches depth (depthReached) but is back up in less than minRepMs (450 ms), so it is silently ignored: no rep, no partial, no repCancelled. 4 reps. targetReps 30.
